walkthroughs.body_html:
This topic is part of the CCEA GCSE Biology specification.

Photosynthesis & Plants appears in the assessment, so it's worth knowing well.

You'll meet Photosynthesis & Plants in exam questions and need to apply your knowledge.

The CCEA board expects you to understand both the concepts and how to use them.

Use the activities in this adventure to build familiarity with Photosynthesis & Plants.

Practise vocabulary, calculations and free-text questions to lock in the learning.
